description: CONCAT of three text literals
A single argument is returned unchanged
Empty-string literals add nothing (no delimiter)
CONCAT of only empty strings is empty text
A space is not empty and is kept
Blank cells in a range add nothing
Stored empty text is the same as a blank for CONCAT
An all-blank range concatenates to empty text
A blank scalar cell argument adds nothing
0 is not empty; concatenates as "0"
FALSE concatenates as "FALSE"
Numbers and bools coerce like &
Negative numbers keep the minus sign
A numeric cell coerces like a scalar number
2-D array literal flattens row-major
Multiple array arguments concatenate in argument order
Empty pieces inside an array add nothing
A 2-D range is flattened left-to-right, then top-to-bottom
Two column ranges join in argument order (not a 2-D walk)
A single row concatenates left-to-right
A single column concatenates top-to-bottom
Blanks inside a 2-D range are skipped, order is still row-major
Microsoft-style CONCAT of two cells with a space
A mixed range coerces numbers/bools and skips blanks
CONCAT flattens a defined name that refers to a range
CONCAT of a defined name that refers to one cell
A formula cell in the range is evaluated, then concatenated
An & expression is a single already-concatenated argument
Nested CONCAT is flattened as a scalar text argument
Unicode scalars concatenate; emoji is kept
CONCAT() with no arguments is #VALUE!
Error in a text argument propagates
Left-to-right: first argument error wins
First error in a flattened range wins
First error in an array literal wins
A missing-sheet range is #REF!
A missing-sheet cell is #REF!
An undefined name is #NAME?
A result of exactly 32767 UTF-16 units is allowed
Result longer than 32767 characters is #VALUE!
33 copies of a 1000-character cell exceed 32767
32766 ASCII + one emoji (2 UTF-16 units) is #VALUE!
32×1000 + 767 characters is exactly 32767
